technical_issues.issue: 600 km SSO inclination quoted as 87.7924 deg / 87.79 deg; correct J2 SSO ~97.8 deg. Plot shows 97-98 deg, contradicting table.
Kourou latitude quoted as 45.05 deg N; actual ~5.2 deg N, invalidates two-windows-per-day claim reasoning.
Claims average contact almost twenty minutes but STK table mean 580.786 sec (~9.7 min); misinterpretation.
RAAN 27.33 deg claimed to indicate launch facility location; RAAN is orbit plane orientation, not site latitude.

overall: Single-sat GBR fluid-lensing mission with full segment coverage and STK evidence, but marred by critical orbit inclination and site errors plus citation policy breach.

feedback.summary: You produced a complete single-satellite GBR fluid-lensing concept with STK evidence across launch, orbit and ground segments. Your Introduction, Orbit, Launch, Ground Control & Communications and Conclusion cover all required areas. To reach Accomplished you need to correct critical technical errors and add detail, quantitative synthesis and consistent referencing.
next_steps: Correct Orbit table to ~97.8 deg SSO inclination, fix Kourou latitude to ~5.2 deg N, and align RAAN and contact-time interpretation with your STK plots and Image 4 access table.
Clearly distinguish operator vs customers in Introduction and strengthen swath/revisit analysis to justify single-satellite coverage of the GBR.
Replace Wikipedia source, fix reference formatting and caption numbering, and add quantitative conclusions and forward recommendations in Conclusion.

criteria.C1: You did well defining coral reef monitoring need and justifying only one satellite is required. For Accomplished, clearly separate operator from customers and add detail on who operates and who uses data.
criteria.C2: You did well covering Vega E launch, 600 km orbit elements, STK views and Mt Pleasant accesses. For Accomplished, correct 87.79 deg to ~97.8 deg, Kourou latitude, RAAN claim and 20-min vs 9.7-min contacts, and strengthen coverage.
criteria.C3: You summarised polar SSO, ground station location and Vega E risk well. For Accomplished, add specific quantitative synthesis from your evidence and clear forward recommendations, not generic statements.
criteria.C4: You used clear headings, abstract and labelled STK figures/tables with readable writing. For Accomplished, remove Wikipedia, make referencing consistent, and number all captions consistently.
